descriptions.Findings and observations: Findings written from facts, with criteria, condition, impact, root cause and recommendation in the team's structure, in English, Spanish, Portuguese and Italian.
descriptions.Risks and controls: Risk descriptions and control designs with every field the team expects, and N/A where the rating or the owner was not given.
descriptions.Testing and workpapers: A testing procedure with its workpaper, step verdicts from the fixed vocabulary, and a sampling design that documents population and selection.
descriptions.Document generation: Planning memos, closing memos, management action plans, AI usage and data strategy documents in the team's sections.
descriptions.Meeting and walkthrough notes: Notes that record what was said and by whom, with no invented dates, decisions or opinions, and preparation for a process walkthrough.
descriptions.Emerging technology audits: Controls for a GenAI application and a scope challenge argued from the figures given.
descriptions.Domain expertise: Auditor judgement: the right criterion, root cause instead of symptom, design before operating effectiveness, full population before sampling, residual risk only from tested controls.
descriptions.Format fidelity: The sections, fields and order of the team's templates, complete, with both deliverables when the task needs two.
descriptions.House style: The team's fixed vocabulary: PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED and PENDING as the only verdicts, no long dashes, no labels of its own.
descriptions.Evidence discipline: N/A where the data was not given instead of an invented owner, date, clause, rating or decision; test evidence kept over management's word.
descriptions.Multilingual: The deliverable in the language of the request with every label translated and nothing left in English.
descriptions.Task recognition: Applies the methodology to audit work and stays out of the way on everything else.
descriptions.Request comprehension: Reads the request before writing: an accepted risk is not a finding, the criterion comes from the right clause, evidence and assertions are kept apart.
